**Yes — most drivers can renew online.**

From the **California Driver's License Renewal Guide** (concept mockup page):

> **1. Can I renew my California driver's license online?**
> **Yes — most drivers can renew online. Start in MyDMV with Online Driver's License Renewal.**
> 
> Use your MyDMV account to begin the online renewal. The online service will walk you through eligibility questions and your current license...

**Where to start:**
- On this page click/button: **"Start: Check online renewal"**
- Service name/location: **MyDMV > Online Driver's License Renewal** using your MyDMV account.
